test_title: PYST 14: SSC CHSL 2023 - General Knowledge (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Identify the true statement.

options.text: If real GDP is 240 and price index is 120 , nominal GDP is 200.
If real GDP is 500 and price index is 200 , nominal GDP is 250.
If real GDP is 500 and price index is 200 , nominal GDP is 700.
If real GDP is 240 and price index is 120 , nominal GDP is 288.

solution:
The correct answer is __**If real GDP is 240 and price index is 120 , nominal GDP is 288.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nominal GDP:-**

 
 
• It is calculated by multiplying the real GDP by the price index.
 
• **The nominal GDP should be 288 (240 x 120/100). **
